bullets: Tech/AI capex jitters dominate: Intel -21%, Amazon FCF -$42.4B, ServiceNow -27%, Alphabet revenue miss drag Nasdaq futures down ~2%.
Oil jumped on Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure, Brent near $112-116, adding inflation worry ahead of today's Employment Cost Index.
Asia tumbled overnight (Kospi -5%, Nikkei -2.5%) on AI-spending fears; record $6.3B Binance-linked crypto hack also pressured risk appetite.
VIX up ~1.7% to 17.2 and US10Y easing toward 4.99% (bull-steepening); tone is risk-off into month-end despite falling yields.

CRM.why: CRM fell with the whole SaaS group after ServiceNow's 19% post-earnings crash on slowing contract growth hit Salesforce (-6%), Workday, Adobe. No CRM earnings miss; DA Davidson cut to Neutral but raised PT to $250, Cantor reiterated Overweight $300.
CRM.bull: Sector-wide SaaS selloff, not CRM-specific damage; Cantor keeps $300 target, valuation looks cheap.
CRM.bear: Braze acquisition overhang plus DA Davidson's downgrade add standalone caution despite the price-target hike.

WEX.why: WEX beat Q3 EPS/revenue and raised FY guidance, but Morgan Stanley downgraded to Equal-Weight (PT raised 172->178) on fuel-price-driven beat quality; market questioned whether growth is sustainable without temporary tailwinds, driving the post-earnings slide.
WEX.bull: Headline beat and raised full-year guidance show fundamentals still improving despite the selloff.
WEX.bear: Morgan Stanley's downgrade flags beat quality reliant on fuel prices, not durable volume growth.

ADP.why: ADP beat Q1 EPS/revenue and raised revenue/EPS guidance, yet Citigroup and Morgan Stanley downgraded to Neutral/Equal-Weight same day; stock fell on premium valuation as margin-expansion guidance held flat despite the beat, disappointing elevated expectations.
ADP.bull: Revenue growth guidance raised to ~6% and EPS growth raised to 10-12%; the beat was real.
ADP.bear: Two same-day downgrades (Citi, Morgan Stanley) on valuation show the stock priced in more than delivered.
flags: two same-day analyst downgrades on ADP

MOH.why: MOH fell after Q3 showed medical cost ratio rising to 92.9% and a thin 0.6% pretax margin; JPMorgan, UBS, Morgan Stanley and RBC all moved to Neutral-type ratings on margin concerns despite reaffirmed 2026 EPS guidance of at least $5.25.
MOH.bull: 2026 EPS guidance of at least $5.25 reaffirmed; management calls this the margin cycle's low point.
MOH.bear: MCR rising to 92.9% plus four analyst downgrades to Neutral/Equal-Weight signal real margin deterioration.
flags: four analyst downgrades aimed at MOH

GDDY.why: GDDY beat Q3 EPS and met/exceeded guidance on Oct 29, yet shares still dipped on valuation/insider-selling focus; a Cantor downgrade from Oct 19 and an older securities-fraud suit tied to a Feb 2026 bookings miss linger but aren't new catalysts.
GDDY.bull: Earnings beat with guidance met across all key metrics; no fresh fundamental damage found.
GDDY.bear: Stock fell despite the beat, suggesting the market sees a risk analysts haven't flagged yet.
